purpose: Audit whether live crane-girder role hypotheses are supported by detected column context and make that uncertainty visible in the active Studio inspector

column_support_context.method: Read-only reproduction of backend _runway_column_context geometric filters against live candidate geometry and candidate column footprints; beam endpoint margin 0.6 m, candidate-height and strip-overlap checks retained.
column_support_context.interpretation: 98/99 candidates lack a distinct two-column endpoint pair under current geometric rules. This indicates missing support evidence, not proof that a physical beam or column is absent.

implementation.behavior: The right-hand inspector now displays the candidate's structural role and whether it is a recognizer hypothesis or a human-reviewed label. For beams it explains whether columns are paired at both ends, only nearby supports were found, or no column relationship was established.

remaining: Independent physical labels for the 99 beam hypotheses and 376 columns
Field precision/recall and dimensional accuracy on a holdout
